reason: The cited evidence does not directly test or demonstrate the effect of substrate preheating on thermal gradients, residual stress, or dimensional precision in SLM of HEAs. E1 discusses post-process heat treatment of cast EHEAs, not in-situ preheating during SLM. E2 only mentions pre-heating as a future strategy to explore. E3 focuses on SLM process optimization for density and mechanical behavior without preheating. Thus, the key premises lack specific prior experimental support from the cited passages.
